set.body:
Parent instrument bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ, reality-check-20261015. Bounded pure arithmetic slice after independent design review: implement paired participant-primary historical risk readout from already validated fixed support/outcomes. No file reader, gold, prediction importer, model, scientific claim or new superiority threshold. Guarded support/data orchestration remains parent scope.

Files: tools/recall-study/historical_risk_readout.py; tests/test_historical_risk_readout.py. Reuse fixed_support_risk.py unchanged. Parent owns policy, exposure guard, any I/O and integration. One writer per scope; preserve unrelated work.

API summarize(population, arms, *, config): population is frozen eligible participant -> ordered unit IDs (all nonempty); arms exactly all17-shipped/all17-monofill -> exactly ownAnchorMass/emittedSceneMass/leafMass -> participant -> unit ID -> existing fixed_support_risk.Outcome. Correctness must agree across score series per arm/unit. Caller separately runs exact-scene and within-one outcomes, using identical deterministic draws from sorted participants. No participant/unit loss, score filling, global cross-participant ranking or decoder selection. Reject malformed/missing inventories before calculation. Return exact Fractions for arithmetic plus structured Available/Unavailable point/interval reasons; transport serialization is later parent scope.

Acceptance:
1. Reuse whole-tie/rational-ceiling kernel. Full-population equal-participant accuracy primary and pooled accuracy secondary remain defined without scores. All risk/area means use equal participant weighting; no extra pooled selective-risk estimand. B-minus-A for both accuracy and risk/area. Preserve each participant's native partial area/domain; full AURC only with complete scores.
2. For each score fix common c=min original attainable coverage over both arms/all eligible participants; integrate the existing right-step curve on [0,c], clipping final width without splitting a selected tie. c=0 gives unavailable/no-positive-domain. Native unequal-domain areas cannot substitute for comparable common/full AURC.
3. Validate committed scoring-config schema/estimand: seed int, resamples>=40 int, confidence0.95, paired-participant-cluster-percentile/explicit indices/unitWeight1. Actual frozen config is seed20260902/2000. Generate one matrix of n draws with replacement from sorted n participants, retain multiplicities, reuse across all arms/scores/metrics; digest matrix for provenance. Preserve original point/full-AURC availability masks and common endpoint under every replicate. Paired differences derive from paired replicate differences, not CI subtraction. 95% percentile indices are floor(n/40), floor(39n/40)-1, exact arithmetic, no interpolation. Fewer than2 participants -> interval unavailable, not a zero-width confidence claim. Pointwise intervals, not simultaneous bands.
4. Exact conditional random-ranking reference: among each arm/score/participant's M scored units, E errors, expected available-cutoff risk E/M; native partial area E/N; common-domain area c*E/M; complete full-AURC reference full error. Preserve score multiset/ties/missingness, no random scene predictor/shuffle approximation/p-values. Report observed-minus-reference risk/area with same paired draws and masks; zero-containing interval is inconclusive, not chance/equivalence.
5. Per-participant and leave-one-participant-out sensitivity: omit each identity, hold original arm/paired masks and common c, recompute defined participant means/common areas/paired differences and full participant/pooled accuracy on remaining n-1; include omitted identity and remaining participant/unit counts; estimates only/no new bootstrap; empty remaining sample unavailable.
6. Independent synthetic oracles: three people A/B/C with sizes1/1/9 and accuracy differences-1/0/+1, forced draw[A,A,C] yields-1/3 not dedup0 or pooled7/11; identical heterogeneous arms paired differences exactly0; unavailable original point stays unavailable when offending person omitted; original c=1/2 stays fixed under draws containing only fully scored people; enumerate three-unit score multiset[1,1,0],1 scored error+1unscored unit: expected native area1/4/common endpoint1/4 area1/12; 2000 distinct rational replicates use indices50/1949. Retain existing kernel tests rather than duplicating them. Targeted pure checks only during active capture62320. Named compiling mutants/controls and exact independent review required before actual readout; parent handles final gate/evidence.

This corrects the later shipped-vs-monofill historical risk analysis, not the original shipped-vs-unblended preregistration. All observed participants/old strata are previously exposed. No new gold/support read, efficacy/calibration/generalization or original-launch attestation is authorized by this arithmetic slice. No commits/main/push/publication by helper.
